confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most grounded; hotel and hostel anchors assume typical July rates including taxes and fees and are plausibly within about ±25%. Cocktail and wine are set from the beer anchor at about 2.3x and 2.0x because direct knowledge of Penang bar pricing is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that point to rba.gov.au; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Malaysian heritage tourism cities such as Melaka and Ipoh, with regional Southeast Asian city-break pricing as a cross-check. Accommodation anchors reflect the concentration of budget-to-midrange guesthouses and hostels in George Town. Food and drink anchors follow Malaysian hawker and casual-restaurant pricing, with alcohol reflecting Malaysia's comparatively high drink prices.
